declarations.name: VeraField
declarations.description: Wires a form control the consumer writes to its label, hint, count and errors, and renders nothing itself. The control is the [data-vera-part="control"] element, else the first labelable one; the <label> is pointed at it, the hint and count describe it, and the error that shows is chosen from the control's ValidityState once the user has tried (an edit and a blur, or a submit). A user's failed submit focuses the first invalid control in tree order, as native does, and the field cancels native bubbles unless native-messages is set. An error the server rendered (data-when="server") stands until the first edit. The count speaks once per crossing, in the consumer's words and the language's plural form.

attributes.name: native-messages
attributes.description: Leave the browser's own validation bubble in place: the field does not cancel `invalid`. Read when it fires.

attributes.name: count-message
attributes.description: What the count says near the limit; {left} interpolates the characters left. Read when it speaks, after count-message-<category>. Default "{left} characters left" ("1 character left" at one).

attributes.name: count-message-zero
attributes.description: count-message for the plural category "zero" of {left} in the field's language (Intl.PluralRules, the closest lang).

attributes.name: limit-message
attributes.description: What the count says at the limit. Read when it speaks. Default "Limit reached".

cssParts.name: control
cssParts.description: The control the field wires, when it is not the first labelable element in the field.

cssParts.name: hint
cssParts.description: Help text; the control is described by it.

cssParts.name: error
cssParts.description: An error message. data-when names the ValidityState key it is for (valueMissing, typeMismatch, …), "server" for one the server rendered (it stands until the first edit), or nothing for the catch-all; a part left empty shows the browser's validationMessage. Only the chosen one is shown; the others get hidden.

cssParts.name: count
cssParts.description: Shows "length / maxlength" for a control with a maxlength, and describes the control.
